name: book-lint
description: Mechanical copyedit linter/fixer for markdown manuscripts. Scan mode reports typographical issues with line numbers (straight vs smart quotes, unbalanced dialogue quotes with the continued-dialogue convention honoured, multiple/trailing spaces, tabs, space-before-punctuation, doubled punctuation, repeated words, hyphen/en-dash used as a dash, mixed ellipsis and em-dash styles). Fix mode returns corrected file texts applying ONLY unambiguous transforms: quote smartening, ellipsis normalization to the dominant style, whitespace cleanup, space-before-punctuation removal — judgement-shaped findings (repeated words, dash style, quote balance) are never auto-fixed. Use scan first, review, then fix.

ellipsis.description: Fix mode: force ellipsis style instead of detecting the dominant one.
